name: Eric Melloul
current_role: Chairman of the Board, Oatly Group AB; independent lead director, The Vita Coco Company; Senior Advisor (ex-Managing Director), Verlinvest
profile: Consumer-goods investor who spent 2008-2024 as a Managing Director of Verlinvest, the Brussels-based de Mevius family investment firm, where he backed Vita Coco (board since ~2008-2010) and Oatly (board since Nov 2016; now chairman). Earlier at AB InBev and McKinsey. SEC-reported holdings relate to these board/insider positions.
interesting_fact: Told Foodinc in 2021 that Oatly was the first company in Verlinvest's food & beverage portfolio to go public, and that Verlinvest had pushed Oatly's management toward China, bringing in China Resources as a partner.
deep_cut_fact: Before private equity he was Global Marketing VP and China Commercial Head at Anheuser-Busch InBev (2003-2008), and before that an Associate Partner at McKinsey & Company (1999-2003).
notes: Company bios differ on Verlinvest dates (Vita Coco page: MD Aug 2008-Feb 2024, now Senior Advisor; Oatly page: Senior Advisor Mar 2024-Jun 2025). Best route likely via Oatly/Vita Coco IR or Verlinvest. Investor bio pages blocked automated fetch; facts taken from search extracts of them.

name: Liang Chen
current_role: Chairman, Jiangsu Hichain Logistics Co., Ltd. (Hichain, 300873.SZ)
profile: Liang Chen (梁晨, b. 1962) founded Hichain Logistics in Wujiang, Suzhou in Aug 2011 and is its controlling shareholder; it listed on Shenzhen ChiNext in 2020 and provides supply-chain logistics, logistics equipment and warehouse automation for consumer-electronics, EV, semiconductor and other manufacturers. She signs the 2024 ESG report as chairman.
interesting_fact: Her career started in finance, not logistics: she was an accountant at Guangdong Weiguo Machinery Factory (1980-89) and worked at China Construction Bank Wujiang branch (1989-99) before running trading and logistics firms.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Hichain she was general manager of Haichen Trading (1999-2003) and then of Hengtong Haichen (2003-2011), the predecessor logistics business, per the IPO prospectus.
notes: Female founder (prospectus: 梁晨女士). Hurun co-listing Yang Xi is a fellow Hichain director/vice GM. IR email is the securities department contact published in the 2024 ESG report.

name: Chen Guoxing
current_role: Shareholder (approx. 3.6%, sixth-largest) of Shanghai Medicilon (688202.SH); not an officer or controlling holder
profile: 陈国兴 is a Medicilon shareholder (4.875m shares, ~3.62% per a 2024 company announcement) and is reported to be the founder of Wuxi Hongqiao Hospital. Medicilon, a preclinical CRO, is controlled by Chen Chunlin and Chen Jinzhang; the company said Chen Guoxing is not a controlling shareholder.
notes: Caution: Oct 2024 reports (Huxiu/Economic Observer, Yicai) say his Medicilon stake was judicially frozen by Wuxi police in connection with an investigation linked to Wuxi Hongqiao Hospital. Not a suitable podcast prospect without further checks. Sources: https://www.huxiu.com/article/3660608.html , https://www.yicai.com/news/102288355.html

name: Zhuang Zhannuo
current_role: Co-actual controller of Shenzhen Zhongzhuang Construction Group (002822.SZ); formerly director and president (current role after Jan 2026 board re-election not confirmed)
profile: 庄展诺 (b. March 1986) is, with Zhuang Zhong (b. 1962, former chairman), an actual controller of Zhongzhuang Construction, a Shenzhen-listed building decoration and construction contractor. He served as a director and president of the company.
notes: Caution: a 2025 CSRC Shenzhen administrative penalty decision names the company, Zhuang Zhong and Zhuang Zhannuo over overstated profits in 2017-2021 annual reports (https://www.csrc.gov.cn/shenzhen/c104320/c7553850/content.shtml). Not a straightforward outreach target.
